about: What bb tool diagrams runs: PlantUML and Mermaid, diagrams drawn from text. Needs jdk and playwright beside it.
label: Diagram renderers (PlantUML, Mermaid)
name: diagrams

run:
dst="$2"; mkdir -p "$dst/bin" "$dst/lib"; cp "$1" "$dst/lib/plantuml.jar"; printf '#!/bin/sh
here="$(dirname "$(readlink -f "$0")")"
exec "${JAVA:-java}" -Djava.awt.headless=true -jar "$here/../lib/plantuml.jar" "$@"
' > "$dst/bin/plantuml"; chmod +x "$dst/bin/plantuml"; npm install --silent --no-audit --no-fund --prefix "$dst" @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli; ln -sf ../node_modules/.bin/mmdc "$dst/bin/mmdc"
